job.title: [Post] Hiring: Tech Lead – Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) We are looking for an experienced Tec…

tailoring.headline: Tech Lead E-Commerce | SAP Commerce Cloud, Java & REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, Git, code reviews and agile teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Tech Lead – Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC)
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Tech Lead position at your organization. With over 5 years of professional experience building, extending, and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in scalable backend architectures, RESTful APIs, and complex platform integrations.

bullets.label: Enterprise E-Commerce Platforms
bullets.text: Designed and implemented robust backend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing, and customer data management following platform best practices.

bullets.label: API & Headless Integrations
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs for storefront and third-party consumers, customizing Interceptors, Populators, and Converters for seamless data flows.

bullets.label: Data Pipelines & Architecture
bullets.text: Engineered and optimized high-performance data pipelines using Profisee PIM, Hotfolders, and DataHub to synchronize product catalogs across global channels and resolve complex ERP-to-platform bottlenecks.

bullets.label: Technical Leadership & Delivery
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring to reduce latency, executed CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, performed code reviews, and provided technical guidance to junior developers within agile teams.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German residence and work permit without sponsorship requirements, and am serving a notice period until 15 December 2026, with an earliest start date of 16 December 2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my technical leadership and platform engineering background can contribute to your team.

tailoring.why_company: I am eager to bring my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce architecture and API integration expertise to your team. Your commitment to high-performance digital platforms aligns perfectly with my background in scaling complex backend systems, optimizing data pipelines, and leading technical delivery across international environments.
tailoring.motivation_short: Driving scalable e-commerce platform architecture, high-performance REST APIs, and robust enterprise integrations with 5+ years of hands-on technical experience.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Dear Rakshita, I saw your opening for a Tech Lead and wanted to connect. With 5+ years building enterprise e-commerce platforms, Java/Spring architectures, and REST APIs at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong technical delivery experience. Let's connect!
tailoring.offer: In my first months, I will leverage my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce experience to optimize platform architecture, accelerate REST API and PIM/ERP integrations, and drive robust CI/CD deployment cycles. I am ready to contribute immediately starting 16.12.2026.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Tech Lead – Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Rakshita Pyati,

I am an experienced e-commerce developer and technical lead with over 5 years of professional experience building enterprise platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I specialize in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, microservices, and complex platform integrations. Based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit, I am available starting 16.12.2026. My complete CV and cover letter are attached to this email, and I look forward to discussing how I can support your engineering team.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
